payload.text: 0073 (S to M), menuz adopts ArcaMasthead: LANDED as 6583e70 (19 Oct 08:27:59Z, by path, not pushed), menuz 0.4.0 on 4e6903f, each file's change identical to the approved 9bb70e1b; verified by vc by change and by dc (check-landing.sh, slot 94). The design, with item 1 amended as cd965bb: the app's pins live at Menuz.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace/xcshareddata/swiftpm/Package.resolved, arca_swift 0.1.1 at 5a17571c (slots 79, 84 and 85). vc's four landing conditions were in first: dc's shellcheck 0.9.0 clean and utilz test menuz on Linux 1..130 with one skip (AC-06.3, no rsvg-convert, as on main), both in slot 87; menuz.bats under /bin/bash 3.2.57, 103 of 103, in slot 89; gtools-ic's review blocking nothing. install_e2e.bats 1..11 in slot 91. Dev installed in slot 92 (08:28:30Z to 08:28:59Z): Menuz 0.4.0, build 1280, 6583e700, one copy running; its render opens with menuz 0.4.0 over 6583e700 · dev, and Desks... ticks zeopit; the build changed no tracked file. hv looked at 0.4.0 and said "LGTM!" to the four checks, with screenshots (vc, 08:38Z), but the row shows no icon, while masthead.yaml says icon: app and help/menuz.md and the CHANGELOG say "with menuz's icon". Read so far: arca 0.1.1's MastheadRow sets item.image to a 32 by 32 copy of NSApplication.shared.applicationIconImage at init and at each open of its own menu when icon is app (MastheadRow.swift apply and read); menuz's masthead.yaml parses to app (no refusal in menuz.log); Menuz.app and Gtools.app carry the same icon keys and resources (CFBundleIconFile and CFBundleIconName AppIcon, AppIcon.icns, AppIcon in Assets.car, LSUIElement); Gtools makes its row the same way; this Mac is macOS 27.0.1. gtools-ic (reads): Gtools' row draws its icon because GtoolsApp.swift:95 to :98 sets NSApp.applicationIconImage at launch, as arca's example does; menuz is the first adopter to leave AppKit's default. The fix-forward design is in issue 0073, committed as 2d1ea40: a red IdentityRowTests case (the row's image is 32 by 32 and draws, its failure message measuring the default), then MenuzMasthead.row setting NSApplication.shared.applicationIconImage from the bundle's AppIcon before it makes the row (the launch path is skipped under the test host), no doc change, and no version bump proposed (vc and hv to say). vc approved the design (09:03Z) with three notes: the set's doc comment says it is app-wide state set from a function that makes a row, and why it lives there; the red first, and if it passes on main, stop and bring vc the measurement before any code; if arca_swift 0.2.0 takes gtools-ic's icon change, 0072 removes menuz's line in the same commit. No version bump and no CHANGELOG line (vc tells hv). Slot 100 (09:05:36Z to 09:06:44Z): the first red stayed green (appIcon: the row's image is set, 32 by 32, and draws under the XCTest host), so no code; no automated test can launch the app as hv runs it. vc chose (09:09Z) the designed fix with a discriminating red: (a) AppIcon.icns loaded by URL (bundle.url(forResource:withExtension:) and NSImage(contentsOf:)), never by name; (b) appIcon pins the mechanism, the row's image all NSBitmapImageRep, red on main, with non-nil, 32 by 32 and draws as guards; (c) the outcome is hv's eye on the dev install, and if no icon shows, a separate diagnostic build, never landed; (d) no diagnostic in landed code, the comment at the set saying why. sc (via gtools-ic): no public icon: in arca; an in-row rasteriser if arca must cope. Slot 102: red on the representation pin alone (the default: one NSCGImageSnapshotRep 256x256). Slot 105: the green failed on the same pin, since AppKit snapshots whatever it is given, so that pin (vc's) could never pass; iconNote passed. vc then chose options 1 and 2: the pin dropped, appIcon keeping non-nil, 32 by 32 and draws, and the launch note measuring each icon's representations and the pixels it colours of 1024 at 32 by 32, through one describe and one pixelsDrawn in Masthead.swift that the test calls too. Slot 112: the icon tests green, its rc 1 from idsUnderContention, 0086's race (filed). critic-swift's two reads were taken in full (the guards and controls, the required note, CFBundleIconFile, the three-way guard, read as beside now, iconKept from a blank icon); slot 116 (09:45:52Z to 09:46:11Z) green: MenuzTests 42, MenuzKitTests 143, the by-name control passing. vc approved the bytes (234360b8) and gave the landing word: LANDED as 8a750cc (09:48:08Z, by path, not pushed, no bump, no CHANGELOG line), re-applied on 1286339 byte-identical; the SHA is with vc and dc. Now: slot 123, the dev install (run-0073-icon-install.sh, heavy, pinning no head), booked with vc, which books every Utilz run since gtools-vc handed it the host queue (19 Oct): its START is in, first in the heavy lane after the compacts, nothing run before its GO. Then hv's look at the row's icon, and the launch note's before part, the first measurement of AppKit's default in the launched app, to vc with the END. Then close 0073 with the evidence. hv pushed ceba425, and dispatch run 39239328116 is green on it, its menuz app job on Xcode 26.6 included (vc): that is 6583e70's CI proof; 8a750cc is a Swift change after it, so the dispatch runs again at the 2.14.1 head.
